title: Downtown Oasis w/ Private Entry
description:
Just 10 min from Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone Arena, & the Ryman, this newly built private suite between The Nations & Germantown is the perfect home base for your Nashville stay. Enjoy a stocked mini fridge, microwave, automatic blinds, Nespresso, double shower head, Dyson Hot+Cool fan, SmartTV, private bathroom, Tempur-Pedic queen bed, private parking, & complementary EV charging. 
A quiet place to recharge. 

Thanks for choosing a local.
Can’t wait to share my hometown with you.

The space
Bedroom,  attached bathroom, and outdoor entrance.

Guest access
Guests have access to the bedroom and its attached bathroom. It is closed off from the rest of the home.

During your stay
Entry is contactless with gate and door entry code provided before check-in

Other things to note
Early check-in and late Check-out is available upon request for a fee. 
Message to see availability.
